letter.role_title: Working Student Software Development & Cloud Solutions on SAP BTP (f/m/d)
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Software Development & Cloud Solutions on SAP BTP. Building cloud solutions on SAP's platform is the direction I have been working towards, from the SAP Young Professionals Program to my SAP Integration Developer certification.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau. I worked in SAP data & analytics at TallyMarks Consulting and as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea, and I was selected as one of 10 participants from Pakistan for the SAP Young Professionals Program.

achievements.impact: in the SAP Young Professionals Program I studied SAP Cloud Integration concepts including iFlows, message mappings and integration scenarios, and earned the SAP Certified Associate: Integration Developer certification
I designed and implemented SAP Datasphere data pipelines connecting the required sources during a 42-dashboard migration from SAP BW
I use Python (Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch) from my B.S. in Artificial Intelligence and my current M.Sc.

letter.problems_section: In your team I would take ownership of my tasks in the development process, learn SAP BTP and your architecture quickly, and contribute where data integration, APIs and analytics meet. I am motivated to grow my software development skills in a real product environment.
letter.closing: I am available immediately and can commit the weekly hours you ask for. I would be glad to discuss how I can contribute.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
